scope: Post hoc office0 scoring diagnostics, CPU stdlib only; no candidate GT, no hypothetical reconstruction quality, no best-quality parameter selection
limitations: Events within seeds/trajectories are dependent; event correlations are descriptive, not inference.
Regret is the known baseline score lost within the same candidate group, not a ground-truth or reconstruction quality loss.
No candidate image/GT/normal recomputation; valid/positive fractions and D are current-map proxy signals.
Different methods and protocols follow different trajectories/maps; their D distributions and timings do not isolate a gate/kernel causal effect.
Lambda grid is post hoc exploratory office0 analysis; scores are real-valued from float32 logs, and close ties may reorder.
B/path variables partly enter regret algebraically; correlation with regret cannot be interpreted as a causal explanation.

time/confidence_nooracle.scope: Diagnostic utility timer includes rendering/visibility/scoring and GPU synchronization; not an isolated geometry kernel. path timer includes search, score and waypoint extraction. other is ledger minus these timers. Diagnostic IO is separate.
